versions.changelog:
- Minor documentation update for greater clarity in the "Going further" section
- Updated project description from "workspace-as-code" to "projects (GTM as Code)"
- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md

- Updated to version 1.0.2.
- Example output now shows full_name, title, and linkedin_url fields instead of previous columns.
- Action example updated: seniority_or and department_or values are now lowercase enum strings (e.g., "c_suite", "vp").
- Added documentation explaining that seniority and department values must be lowercase enums, with lists of accepted values.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.

- Added "personas" to metadata (account-executive, sales-development)
- Changed metadata "source" from "micro-skill" to "one-off"
- Improved setup instructions: session attribution now checks for existing plugin to avoid double-counting
- Added an "Example" section with sample output and credit usage context
- Added guidance for requesting a GitHub star after successful use
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file

Initial release of find-stakeholders:

- Identify the buying committee at a target company using title, seniority, and department filters.
- Integrates with Cargo using the @cargo-ai/cli and aiArk provider.
- Supports asynchronous operations and credit-based pricing (0.05 credits per returned record).
- Step-by-step setup and sample commands included.
- Advises on best practices: sample before running at scale and deduplicate contacts before enriching.
